evidence_legend.JS_CONFIRMED: Found in the Web UI's own JavaScript source, not yet observed on the wire.
evidence_legend.UI_HANDLER_CONFIRMED: A write control's JS handler/payload-builder was read statically; never invoked, no request/response observed.
evidence_legend.DOCUMENTED: Stated in vendor documentation, not observed in traffic or JS.
evidence_legend.INFERRED: A hypothesis with no direct evidence; must be verified before use.

endpoints.request_type: application/json (query-builder body: object, join, fields, where, order, limit, offset)
endpoints.notes: Generic query engine backing all list-shaped reads (users, access_logs, and 88 other objects). Full catalog: artifacts/live_capture/object_catalog.json. where[].connector is concatenated as a raw SQL-looking fragment client-side.

List users. Fields: id, name, registration, password (hash), salt, begin_time, end_time, user_type_id, last_access. SECURITY: exposes password hash+salt to any authenticated caller; SDK must never log/cache/forward these two fields.
Access logs. Fields: id, time, user_id, portal_id, log_type_id, event. Dedicated Reports page paginates this with a date-range where clause; 213 rows over default ~29-day window observed.
Groups. Fields: id, name. Dedicated page GET /en_US/html/group.html.
Schedules (UI term: Time Zones). time_zones: id,name. time_spans: id,time_zone_id,start,end,sun..sat,hol1..hol3. Dedicated page GET /en_US/html/timespan.html.
